surfaces.name: Decision.Arbitration: step, precedence (bands, per-band order, pre-emption, suspension, resumption, cancel permissions, cancel-all, release, waiting limit)

surfaces.name: Graph.TopoSort: sort (Kahn, least-first under the caller's order) and criticalPath (CPM)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 11; cases 11001-11009 (11009: two equally critical predecessors); FsCheck: cycles exactly Scc.cycles, edges forward, equal to a list model for total and non-total orders, makespan equal to brute-force longest path, CPM identities, the critical-path end and trace rules; 10^5 chain under Node's default stack

surfaces.name: Decision.BehaviourTree: compile, initial, tick, tickTraced (memory composites, reactive Sequence and Fallback with priority interrupts and halting, parallel thresholds, decorators, repeat, retry, running-state resumption, blackboard threading)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 12; cases 12001-12012 and, for reactive composites, 12013-12027; FsCheck equality (status, blackboard, trace and state) with a recursive reference interpreter over 8 ticks, and an invariant fuzz of at least 3000 random trees x 24 ticks checking that equality and the halt invariant after every tick; priority-interrupt and halt cases, fail-fast and succeed-fast, re-tick from the first child, tick atomicity when a leaf raises, tick idempotence with constant leaves, idle after finishing; 10^5 deep and wide trees, memory and reactive, under Node's default stack

surfaces.name: Search.Grid.DoorGrid: neighbours, distance, findPath (thin walls, doors, planes and stairs, no corner cutting)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 13; cases 13001-13019 (13014-13019: diagonal < orthogonal and diagonal > 2 x orthogonal); FsCheck over arbitrary positive cost pairs: neighbours equal an independently written adjacency, A* and Dijkstra cost equal an oracle Dijkstra (also on open grids), the heuristic is consistent for every move and exact on open grids; a 10^5-tile corridor under Node's default stack

surfaces.name: Spatial.KdTree: build, nearest, kNearest, withinRadius, inRectangle, distanceSquared (int coordinates -16383..16383)
surfaces.evidence: fixture-schema.v1 operation 14; cases 14001-14006; FsCheck: every query equals a brute-force scan by (distance^2, X, Y, Index) with heavy ties; 10^5 collinear and duplicate points under Node's default stack

notes: Unclassified is not admissible for a new surface (ADR-0098 §3 rule 2); every public surface is listed above.
Changing the output of a LockstepExact surface for any input is a breaking change with a new profileId. The two heap ordering contracts are frozen: FS.GG.Game.Core pins them (ADR-0098 §1).
status becomes published-contract only when a released package carries this profile.
